title: BUG: dev-c from 15.10.2025: In Profile with mg/dl, isf-Graph is shown in mmol
symptom: In a profile using mg/dL, the ISF graph is displayed in mmol instead of mg/dL.
cause: The graph uses the units from the edited profile, which may not be visible in the screenshot.
fix: The issue appears to be resolved in a later version; the axis labels are slightly cut but it works.
evidence_quote: Axis labels slighly cut because of low res phone but it works. I believe this is your issue too
